spec_refs: DNP3 Specification Volume 4 — Data Link Layer

patterns.summary: Data Link Layer length byte vs. actual frame body mismatch.
patterns.fuzzer_notes: Spec limits length to 5..255. Boundary values catch DL parsers.

patterns.summary: DL block CRC (16-bit per 16-byte block) — outstation should drop frame on bad CRC.
patterns.fuzzer_notes: boofuzz Checksum() auto-recomputes; need a static invalid CRC Request to exercise validation path.

patterns.summary: Transport Layer sequence number wraps after 63; parsers that don't handle wrap reorder fragments incorrectly.
Application Layer function codes 0-32 + vendor range; some outstations crash on undocumented codes.
DNP3 defines ~100 object groups with multiple variations each; per-group parser bugs are unexplored.
patterns.fuzzer_notes: Audit recommendation S5 — add a new DNP3_Object_Sweep Request iterating (group, variation) pairs.

patterns.summary: IIN (Internal Indications) flags in responses; master-side parsers historically lax.
patterns.fuzzer_notes: Requires master-emulation mode; not present in current fuzzer.
